verdict.rationale: A hands-on `ultrametric init --dry-run` shows the same skill being written to both Codex (.agents/skills) and Claude Code (.claude/skills) targets. The hosted MCP server can be added in any agent host's remote MCP settings, and both connections share the same process service and records, so work carries across agents. However, Cursor and other named harnesses are never mentioned, and the docs give only one generic MCP instruction rather than per-harness setup steps. Missing for 10: evidenced Cursor and other-harness install targets, documented per-harness installation instructions, and independent corroboration beyond the vendor's own probes.
